crossRefs.note: All the king’s servants who were in the king’s gate bowed down, and paid homage to Haman; for the king had so commanded…

people.name: Haman
people.line: A Persian official who plotted to destroy the Jews.

people.name: Mordecai
people.line: Esther's cousin, a Jewish leader in the Persian court.

translations.web: Mordecai told him of all that had happened to him, and the exact sum of the money that Haman had promised to pay to the king’s treasuries for the destruction of the Jews.
translations.bsb: and Mordecai told him all that had happened to him, including the exact amount of money that Haman had promised to pay into the royal treasury in order to destroy the Jews.
translations.kjv: And Mordecai told him of all that had happened unto him, and of the sum of the money that Haman had promised to pay to the king's treasuries for the Jews, to destroy
translations.asv: And Mordecai told him of all that had happened unto him, and the exact sum of the money that Haman had promised to pay to the king's treasuries for the Jews, to destroy them.
